column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 to UCO Core Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) LinkML schema and the Unified Cyber Ontology (UCO) Core schema. Mappings anchor ISO/IEC 22989 entities to UCO Core foundational classes (UcoThing, UcoObject) to support cyber-incident and digital-forensics integration of AI-related artefacts.

column10: Both serve as the identity / labelled-entity root for their respective schemas.
An AI system can be represented as a UCO object when modelled as an artefact in a cyber-incident graph.
Datasets used by AI systems can be represented as UCO objects in cyber-evidence contexts.
